methods: Pre-update goal index from ordered confirmed events; preceding-interval duration weighting; final hold excluded; existing judge independently matched
contribution_identity: finite3^2 = XY residual at 3D projection^2 + Z residual at 3D projection^2 = infinite3^2 + pre-start excess^2 + post-end excess^2. Optimized finiteXY has its own projection; incremental3DoverXY is not simply vertical target error
backend_separation: Actual Gazebo and native PyBullet are individual rows, never pooled; native gamma grid12 routes/model; v6 selected grid12 routes/arm. Actual observations are existing12 route flights (4 new gamma+8 explicitly shared), not new flights

variable_route_counterexample.conclusion: Two distinct variable-route target histories produce identical74 including integral and lagged memory, but different finite-segment geometry; input-semantic example only, not asserted autonomous-plant trajectories or a collision on the fixed training route

zero_padded_first_layer_probe.conclusion: Algebraic policy preservation, allowing float GEMM rounding; no learned improvement tested

fixed_route_interpretation: All joint samplers instantiate the same ROUTE_POINTS. Initial pose/yaw and wind vary, not waypoint positions/order. Relative goal/velocity/history, yaw reference and integrated error may encode leg identity implicitly. Absence of an explicit segment is proven; unavoidable fixed-route observation aliasing or a causal source of the geometry failure is not proven
proposed_offline_semantic_probe: Retain prior commanded goal on an observed target change; validate finite leg mask and compute heading-transported 3D unit tangent(3), vector from measured p to clamped projection(3), positive post-end excess(1), positive pre-start excess(1), valid-leg mask(1), using previous/current goals only. At reset use mask0; never infer a start from an unvisited future waypoint. Probe identical current74 with two past-goal histories and different finite correction, yaw-rotation equivariance, degenerate legs, delayed/missed goal changes, pre-update event ordering, exact all-row unchanged initial actions after zero-padding, and hold behavior. Such a feature encoder would be a new version, not an in-place change to the immutable74 contract
risks: Variable-route semantic counterexample is not evidence of unavoidable aliasing on the fixed route
Explicit finite geometry cannot itself repair late braking or guarantee any quality metric
Stored previous goal must survive beyond0.2s; integrator is a lossy but longer-term memory already present
Need identical causal target-change timing in train/eval/Gazebo; no reset of old74 memory
A valid leg persists into final hold unless completion is independently derived from measured dwell; adding backend phase would change authorized inputs
Zero columns preserve actor initially, but critic initialization and training KL, observation normalization and optimizer must be controlled separately
Appending columns changes floating GEMM accumulation order slightly; numerical action parity needs a tolerance
Existing frozen encoder/runtime/policy contract is74; any new encoder/runtime must be separately versioned and prospective plan reviewed
